answer: Clone farms mint idle keys because joining is nearly free. Each applicant locks 90 units in a slash-insurance vault and draws one hardware-bound ticket from a public inlet limited to 10 tickets per hour and a 48-hour cool-down. The key posts twelve delayed shale layers and reveals a unique preimage at hours 2 through 24; peers match every reveal to the ticketed pubkey and the locked balance. A twin pays another 90-unit lock plus a new ticket. Miss two reveals and 30 units are slashed with a three-epoch freeze; a duplicated preimage empties the vault and bars that pubkey for six epochs.
